prescreenRequired.note: Portfolio is prescreen-gated; no open live audition.

value.text: Two contrasting dance solos/excerpts, no more than 1 minute each; tell the committee how they contrast.
60-second video introduction responding to a prompt.
Headshot + an action photo (professional photos not necessary; no group shots).
Dance resume uploaded to SlideRoom as a PDF (Kaufman sample format).
Written response of 250 words or less on integrating USC's academic/interdisciplinary opportunities.

videoSpec.note: No ballet-barre segment specified, unlike many peer prescreens. Re-checked Aug 2026 — components unchanged (two 1-min solos, 60-sec intro video, headshot+action photo, resume PDF, 250-word written response).

Fall 2027 dates not yet published as of Aug 2026 — verify closer to Dec 2026.

auditions.notes: Prescreen-gated. Ballet, contemporary, improvisation/freestyle and hip-hop classes + interview + ~2-min solo. Pairs with a Chapman trip. ~25 finalists/day invited (per prior-cycle FAQ).
